facts: Two main islands, Grande-Terre and Petite-Terre, in the northern Mozambique Channel
worth_knowing: Grande-Terre is geologically the oldest of the Comoro Islands, 39 km long and 22 km wide, with Mount Benara reaching 660 m. A coral reef encircles much of the island.
